# Origin and model construction

The private v1.3 library was prepared in a ChatGPT conversation for the user and this public candidate was curated from its STL/STEP artifacts.

**Every included exported mechanical mesh/solid was procedurally generated by ChatGPT (OpenAI) at the user's request.** This is tool attribution, not a claim that OpenAI owns, distributes, warrants or endorses the project. Geometric coordinate inputs have specific upstream sources where specified in THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES.md.

Publishing only generated meshes does not automatically eliminate upstream copyright in adapted EAGLE or KiCad works. We therefore include attribution and a compatible share-alike license, and exclude materials whose provenance is not adequately cleared.

Not included: original Arduino/Mega EAGLE `.brd`/`.sch` downloads; third-party KiCad footprints; vendor STEP models; photographs; trade logos; the private dataset, notebooks, or generator scripts containing coordinates from sources with unresolved permissions. Source generators were excluded until they can be reviewed separately.

This is a reference dataset; it has not been independently measured with calipers, CMM or inspected against production drill/assembly output.
